tank_description: A fast wheeled marksman with exceptional spotting capabilities, armed with a powerful HEAT cannon and equipped with a recon drone, non-line-of-sight missiles. The AMX-10 RC excels at reconnaissance, battlefield control, and supporting allies.

strengths.title: Resistant to Immobilisation
strengths.description: Thanks to it's wheeled nature. The AMX-10RC is adept at avoiding being immobilised. This gives players the option to simply turn and run, even if CC abilities are present, provided it has the time to do so as abilities like mines will at worst, slow you, not stop you.

strengths.title: Versatile Battlefield Role
strengths.description: There is little the AMX-10RC can't dabble in, from brawling, to long range sniping, to aggressive scouting and flanking, players will find they have many options available to them to suit the flow of the game. Aggressive players will find opportunities if they go looking for them.

strengths.title: Reliable Gun
strengths.description: A quick reload, HEAT and a a decent alpha strike, commanders will find the AMX10-RC's main weapon an asset. Thanks to the HEAT shells commanders don't have to worry about their effective ranges when in combat, making this vehicle equally at home in both long and short range engagements.

weaknesses.title: Limited Staying Power
weaknesses.description: A low HP pool, token armour and a reliance on shields means the AMX-10RC will struggle in direct engagements. Whilst capable of snap brawling when it needs to, players should avoid entering such situations as much as possible. An experienced player will be able to destroy you in 2-3 shots.

weaknesses.title: Ability Reliance
weaknesses.description: The AMX-10RC's two primary abilites largely rely on each other to function correctly. This makes the AMX-10RC energy starved to a degree. Whilst both abilities are very useful, commanders will have to know when, and where to deploy them to get the most effect.

tank_summary: The AMX-10 RC is a fast wheeled marksman built around reconnaissance, mobility, and precision firepower. With exceptional spotting capabilities and immunity to immobilisation effects, it can quickly scout enemy positions, relocate across the battlefield, and remain effective where tracked vehicles might be immobilised. Its HEAT rounds deal a respectable 510 damage per shot and suffer no damage drop-off, allowing it to consistently threaten targets at any range.

Supporting its direct fire capabilities is an impressive suite of reconnaissance and indirect fire tools. The AMX-10 RC can deploy a recon drone to gather intelligence and spot targets beyond its own line of sight, while its non-line-of-sight missile system can engage up to three enemy vehicles at once. This combination makes it an extremely versatile vehicle, capable of contributing damage, spotting, and battlefield control simultaneously.

Despite its strengths, the AMX-10 RC remains a fragile platform. Its 2,300 hit point pool is among the lower values for its class, and while it does feature shielding around the front and sides of the vehicle, this protection is temporary and can be stripped away quickly under sustained fire. Commanders who rely too heavily on the shield often find themselves exposed, making careful positioning, scouting, and mobility essential to the vehicle's survival.
